clauses.title: Who is covered
clauses.text: You (the employee), your spouse, up to two children up to age 25, and your dependent parents or parents-in-law (one set, chosen at enrolment).

clauses.title: Adding dependants
clauses.text: Dependants are added at joining or within 30 days of marriage or childbirth. Parents can be added only at joining or at policy renewal.

clauses.title: Sum insured
clauses.text: ₹5,00,000 per policy year, family floater. The sum insured is shared by all covered members of your family (employee, spouse, children and parents). There is no separate cover for parents.

clauses.title: Corporate buffer
clauses.text: Corporate buffer: Acme holds a buffer of ₹25,00,000 for the whole company for critical illness after a family's sum insured is used up, released at HR's discretion.

clauses.title: Room rent limit
clauses.text: Room rent limit: 1% of the sum insured per day (₹5,000 per day) for a normal room, including boarding and nursing.

clauses.title: ICU / ICCU limit
clauses.text: ICU / ICCU: up to 2% of the sum insured per day (₹10,000 per day).

clauses.title: Proportionate deduction waived
clauses.text: Proportionate deduction is waived under this group policy: if you choose a room above the limit, you pay only the extra room rent; other charges are not reduced.

clauses.title: Waiting periods
clauses.text: Pre-existing diseases are covered from day one. The 30-day initial waiting period and the specific-disease waiting periods are waived for all members.

clauses.title: Maternity
clauses.text: Maternity: up to ₹50,000 for a normal delivery or caesarean section, within the family floater. Newborn covered from day one.

clauses.title: Co-payment
clauses.text: Nil co-payment for all members, including parents, under this group policy.

clauses.title: Cover ends on leaving; migration
clauses.text: Cover for you and all your dependants ends on your last working day with Acme. There is no grace period. To keep cover, each covered member may migrate to an individual or family floater policy with Suraksha Health Insurance Ltd (SAMPLE). The migration request, with the migration form, must reach the insurer no later than 15 days before your last working day. Requests received after that are treated as fresh proposals, with medical underwriting and fresh waiting periods.

clauses.title: Migration credit
clauses.text: On migration, credit is given for the time each member has been continuously covered under this group policy, up to the sum insured held here (₹5,00,000), against waiting periods for pre-existing diseases and specific diseases.

clauses.title: Terms after migration
clauses.text: The migrated policy is a retail policy: you pay its premium, and its own terms apply. In particular, room rent limits, proportionate deduction and co-payment for older members may apply even though they are waived under this group policy.

clauses.title: Policy document prevails
clauses.text: This summary does not replace the policy document. Exclusions and definitions are as per the group policy and the insurer's standard wording.

clauses.title: Changes at renewal
clauses.text: Acme may change the group cover at renewal on 1 April each year.
